# Project Context: TrustHub (MERN Stack)
- Architecture: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), React (Vite, Tailwind CSS).
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): User and Admin.
- Core Entities: User (Authentication), Trust (Metadata & Verification Status: Pending, Verified, Rejected).
- Code Style: ES modules (`import/export`), clean modular separation (Controllers, Routes, Models, Middlewares), async/await, proper error handling.
